lines: The app ships no composer/autoload.php, so the server registers its generic loader for lib/ and looks every class up in the file system.

A composer/composer.json with config.vendor-dir ".", config.optimize-autoloader true, a config.autoloader-suffix and autoload.psr-4 {"OCA\\DeskDesk\\": "../lib/"} makes composer dump-autoload write composer/autoload.php with a class map; the code of the app does not change.

lines: 1 verb and path or route name is declared more than once. The server keeps one route per name and takes the first that matches a request, so the other one is never reached.
deskdesk.health.index: deskdesk.health.index at appinfo/routes.php:36 routes, deskdesk.health.index at appinfo/routes.php:37 routes

Nothing in the app calls 5 routes outside OCS. Looked for: a route name or a path in the PHP source and the templates, in 12 files of the frontend source and in the navigation of info.xml. The frontend puts the path of the app and the rest of a URL together at run time, so every text there that reads like a path below the app counted as a call. A route stays behind when the frontend stops calling it. A route that only a client outside the app calls shows here as well, unless its method allows requests from other origins (CORS).
